{{Quote|With Gelba gone, I call the shots. And I say Gelba's death calls for blood!|Draado|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Draado''' was a bearded [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] living on [[Doan]] around [[980 BBY]]. Draado dug up [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] on Doan, which he claimed as his own. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[mining caste]] came into conflict with the [[Doan Royal House]], a conflict which escalated with the death of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] and the [[Massacre on Doan|assassination]] of the mining caste leader, [[Gelba]]. Although Draado had originally called for diplomacy rather than violence, the Sith amulets and talismans corrupted him, making him believe that the mining caste needed to go to war with the Royal family.

Meanwhile, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] arrived on Doan, searching for the artifacts that Draado had dug up. He was led to Draado by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], [[Quano]], and he attacked the miner, quickly killing the four [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]]-carrying guards stationed at the scene. However, with the help of the talismans, Draado called on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to bring a stalactite down on Harth. Harth then drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|threw]] it, killing the other miners present; only Draado managed to dodge the attack. Harth, however, then [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|choked]] Draado through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], killing him. Harth then stole the artifacts from Draado's body before leaving for his [[Set Harth's mansion|home]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
